phase: Phase 4: Background Operation & OS Power Management

stories.title: Android Foreground Service & Sticky Notification
stories.description: Implement IntercomForegroundService with persistent FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_CONNECTED_DEVICE | MICROPHONE notification, audio routing survival, and Bluetooth SCO lifecycle lock.
acceptanceCriteria: Foreground service starts and binds to AudioEngine and MeshTransport
Persistent notification with active peer count and PTT status
Service stops cleanly on explicit user disconnect

stories.title: Android Partial WakeLock & Battery Optimization Helper
stories.description: Implement PowerManagerHelper to acquire PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK and provide user prompt intent for ACTION_REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS.
acceptanceCriteria: Partial WakeLock acquired on service start with reference counting
WakeLock released in onDestroy with leak-prevention try/finally
Battery optimization check and request intent cleanly handled

stories.title: iOS Background Audio & CoreBluetooth Background Modes
stories.description: Configure UIBackgroundModes in Info.plist (audio, bluetooth-central, bluetooth-peripheral) and implement AppDelegate / AudioSession lifecycle.
acceptanceCriteria: UIBackgroundModes includes audio, bluetooth-central, and bluetooth-peripheral
AVAudioSession category PlayAndRecord with voiceChat mode survives background transitions
Native SwiftUI app lifecycle properly initializes background bridge listener

stories.title: iOS Background Task Assertions & Keep-Alive
stories.description: Implement BackgroundKeepAlive in iosMain using UIApplication background task assertions to protect packet forwarding and audio buffer drains during screen lock.
acceptanceCriteria: Task assertion acquired before packet burst forwarding
Assertion expires cleanly with expirationHandler to avoid iOS watchdog termination
State exposed cleanly to Swift via IntercomBridge

stories.title: Screen-Off Continuity Verification Test
stories.description: Automated unit test verifying that MeshTransport, PacketDeduplicator, and AudioEngine state machines survive simulated backgrounding and sleep assertions.
acceptanceCriteria: Simulates incoming mesh packets under simulated screen-off conditions
Verifies zero dropped packets and zero sliding-window memory leak
